name: David McAllister - § 43 - Am 15
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 43. Acknowledges that the requirement for unanimity forces the Member States to work relentlessly to achieve compromise and unity, which is the source of the EU’s political leverage on the world stage; recalls that the CFSP is defined and implemented by the European Council and the Council acting unanimously, except where the Treaties provide otherwise;
